name: v0.3.12 — Aggregator parity fix + GuacWizard hero card + 31-case test suite
releaseNotes:
• Web bankAccountTotals: synthetic-account fallback when user has bank_fees but no bank_statements. Closes the gap where web showed GuacWizard=50 (baseline) while mobile showed 88 (real data). Both engines now produce identical numbers.
• /guacwizard hero card on mobile — matches the web's emerald-tinted card with avocado mascot + GuacWizard title + score X/100. Score computed from the same Dart engine the dashboard tile uses.
• Test infrastructure: 31 cross-platform fixture cases (23 score-formula + 8 aggregation-pipeline). Web JS + Mobile Dart both pass all 31. Test report at test-fixtures/TEST_REPORT.html (open in browser → Ctrl+P → Save as PDF).
• AnomaliesCard + SubscriptionsCard moved to right under the feature-pill row (matches user-requested layout).
